PREFIX kg: <https://wealth.example.org/kg/>

PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>

WHERE {
  # Investor base
  ?inv a wm:Investor .
  ?inv wm:investorId ?investorId .
  OPTIONAL { ?inv wm:investorName ?investorName . }

  # Risk score > 60
  ?ph a wm:PortfolioHealth .
  ?ph wm:investorId ?investorId .
  ?ph wm:riskScore ?riskScore .
  FILTER(xsd:decimal(?riskScore) > 60)

  # At least one Sell rebalancing action
  ?ra a wm:RebalancingAction .
  ?ra wm:investorId ?investorId .
  ?ra wm:action ?action .
  FILTER(LCASE(STR(?action)) = "sell")

    SELECT ?investorId (AVG(xsd:decimal(?progressPct)) AS ?avgProg)
    WHERE {
      ?goal a wm:InvestmentGoal .
      ?goal wm:investorId ?investorId .
      ?goal wm:progressPct ?progressPct .

    GROUP BY ?investorId
    HAVING (xsd:decimal(?avgProg) < 30)
  }

  # Withdrawal amount greater than Deposit amount

    }
    GROUP BY ?investorId
    HAVING (?totalWithdraw > ?totalDeposit)
  }
}
